definitions.gloss: words of resentment; reproach; bitter complaint
definitions.explanation: Words expressing a grudge or accumulated resentment toward someone, usually delivered face-to-face or in a letter. Implies a personal grievance rather than general complaining.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一言|ひとこと}→一言：03708_hitokoto⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{恨|うら}み{言|ごと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{口|くち}にしなかった→口にする：21471_kuchinisuru⟧。
examples.english: She did not say a single word of reproach.

examples.japanese: ⟦{別|わか}れた→別れる：01113_wakareru⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧になって⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧{恨|うら}み{言|ごと}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦メール→メール：04435_meeru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{届|とど}いた→届く：00899_todoku⟧。
examples.english: After we broke up, a long resentful email arrived.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{恨|うら}み→恨み：00414_urami⟧ (grudge) + {言|ごと} (words). The {言|ごと} suffix forms nouns meaning "words/talk of —" (⟦{独|ひと}り{言|ごと}→独り言：07022_hitorigoto⟧, ⟦{寝言|ねごと}→寝言：07393_negoto⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {恨|うら}み{言|ごと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧: to voice resentment
- {恨|うら}み{言|ごと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{並|なら}べる→並べる：01091_naraberu⟧: to reel off complaints
- {恨|うら}み{言|ごと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}く→聞く：00483_kiku⟧: to listen to someone's grievances
- {恨|うら}み{言|ごと}⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧⟦{言|い}わない→言う：00515_iu⟧: to not utter a single word of complaint

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{愚痴|ぐち}→愚痴：06623_guchi⟧: griping — about life or circumstances in general, not directed at a specific person
- ⟦{文句|もんく}→文句：03636_monku⟧: complaint — broader; can be about a product or situation
- ⟦{悪口|わるぐち}→悪口：12672_waruguchi⟧: bad-mouthing — speaking ill of someone behind their back
